title: Verify: Exporter format, empty round and frozen-only unit tests
summary: Unit tests with a fake ExportSource
description: Test Exporter with a fake source, no filesystem.
acceptance_criteria: Given 2 frozen contributions, When exported and marshalled, Then JSON matches the expected literal with version, world, round and entries
Given empty, frozen-only and not-frozen inputs, Then three tests pass asserting [] , exactly 2 of 3 entries, and ErrNotFrozen

steps.action: Define fakeSource implementing ExportSource with in-memory contributions and frozen ids. TestExport_Format: 2 frozen contributions with fixed CreatedAt; json.Marshal the result and assert it equals an expected literal containing version 1, world, round and each entry's id, author, content, created_at.

EmptyRound: frozen=true with no ids; assert marshalled JSON contains "contributions":[]. OnlyFrozen: 3 listed, 2 frozen ids; assert exactly those 2 returned in created_at order. NotFrozen: frozen=false; assert errors.Is(err, ErrNotFrozen).
